observations: A stack of solar panels resting on a trolley or cart.
The panels have silver frames and dark blue cells with visible busbars.
A watermark 'NAGOTECH SOLAR' is visible across the center of the image.
The photo shows the front of the panels; the rear specification labels are not visible.
No battery is visible in the photo despite being mentioned in the text.
The photo is taken outdoors on a dirt or concrete surface.

claims.evidence: The specification label on the back of the panel is not shown in photo 0.
The angle of photo 0 makes it impossible to accurately count the individual cells.
There is no battery visible in photo 0.

risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's specification label on the back of the panel.
A photo of the battery showing its label and a video of it under load or a voltmeter reading.
risks.if_unproven: as panel only, no battery included

risks.proof: A close-up photo of the panel surface or an output test in direct sunlight.

proof_requests: Photo of the specification label on the back of the solar panel.
Photo of the battery mentioned in the description.
Photo of the connectors (MC4) to check for weathering or damage.
response.reason: The high wattage claim (650W) and the inclusion of a battery cannot be verified without a photo of the panel's back label and the battery itself. These are the primary drivers of the price.
